sentences.zh: 如果你使用信用卡，每个月打开账单时，当然会看到

sentences.en: the things that you spent money on, but then you see this other number in the corner that tells you how many points you've earned.
sentences.zh: 你消费的项目，但随后你会看到角落里有另一个数字，告诉你赚取了多少积分。

sentences.en: And you can spend these points on things like vacations and hotel stays and dinners, and it's kind of like free money.
sentences.zh: 你可以用这些积分兑换度假、酒店住宿和晚餐，这感觉就像是免费的钱。

sentences.en: My name is Jamie Lauren Kalis, and I'm a contributing writer to the New York Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰米·劳伦·卡利斯，是《纽约时报》杂志的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: I wrote a story about the world of credit card rewards and airline miles, aka points.
sentences.zh: 我写了一篇关于信用卡奖励和航空里程（也就是积分）世界的文章。

sentences.en: I first got into points when I opened a credit card, racked up some rewards, and was able to take a free vacation to Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 我第一次接触积分是在我办了一张信用卡，攒了一些奖励，然后去越南度了一次免费假之后。

sentences.en: So then a couple months later, I opened another card and got another rewards bonus and took a trip down to D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以几个月后，我又办了一张卡，拿到了另一笔奖励红利，然后去了一趟华盛顿特区，

sentences.en: to see some national parks.
sentences.zh: 去参观了一些国家公园。

sentences.en: I thought to myself, if I could do this once or twice, are there people out there who are doing this at an extreme level?
sentences.zh: 我心想，如果我能这样操作一两次，那有没有人正在把这种事做到极致呢？

sentences.en: I was able to open maybe seven credit cards for the points, but I found guys out there who had open 75.
sentences.zh: 我为了积分大概开了七张信用卡，但我发现有人竟然开了75张。

sentences.en: Most of these guys, and they are mostly guys, were just doing this as a hobby.
sentences.zh: 这些人中的大多数——而且确实大多是男性——只是把这当作一种爱好。

sentences.en: But then I was able to talk to the guy who had built it into a career.
sentences.zh: 但后来我采访到了一位把这做成职业的人。

sentences.en: Brian Kelly is the points guy.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·凯利就是那位“积分达人”。

sentences.en: He was able to turn his knowledge of points into a business and a lifestyle brand.
sentences.zh: 他成功地将自己的积分知识转化为一项事业和一个生活方式品牌。

sentences.en: I first met Brian in February of last year on what felt like one of the last normal days before all anyone was talking about was coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到布莱恩是在去年二月，那感觉像是新冠病毒成为全民话题前，最后几个正常的日子之一。

sentences.en: Within a month of that meeting, because points have so much to do with the travel industry, I was almost certain the story was about to be killed.
sentences.zh: 在那次会面后不到一个月，由于积分与旅游业息息相关，我几乎确信这篇报道要泡汤了。

sentences.en: But the points guy kept going.
sentences.zh: 但这位“积分达人”还在继续。

sentences.en: While I spent the last year holed up in my apartment, I watched as he traveled the world from Palm Springs to Antigua to Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 当我在公寓里闭门不出时，我看着他从棕榈泉到安提瓜，再到墨西哥城，环游世界。

sentences.en: When we last spoke in November, he had just returned from two weeks in
sentences.zh: 我们上次在11月交谈时，他刚从波拉波拉岛回来，

sentences.en: Bora Bora, swimming with humpback whales.
sentences.zh: 在那里度过了两周，还与座头鲸一起游泳。

sentences.en: So I wrote about how he pulls it off, and how America's convoluted financial system makes it all possible.
sentences.zh: 所以我写了关于他是如何做到的，以及美国复杂的金融体系如何让这一切成为可能。

sentences.en: Here's my story, The Man Who Turned Credit Card
sentences.zh: 以下是我的报道《将信用卡积分变成商业帝国的男人》，

sentences.zh: 由爱德华多·巴莱里尼朗读。

sentences.en: They came to Dubrovnik by cruise ship or Ryanair, members of a new hypermobile class of tourists who traveled for cheap and didn't stay long.
sentences.zh: 他们乘坐游轮或瑞安航空来到杜布罗夫尼克，这是一群新型的超流动性游客，他们追求廉价旅行，且停留时间不长。

sentences.en: They'd seen its walled old town on Game of Thrones, and they wanted to be there themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们在《权力的游戏》中看到了那座有城墙的古城，便想亲自去看看。

sentences.en: So they went.
sentences.zh: 于是他们就去了。

sentences.en: Venice, Barcelona, certain beaches in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 威尼斯、巴塞罗那、泰国的一些海滩。

sentences.en: These places had all faced their own over-touristing problems, but even by this standard,
sentences.zh: 这些地方都面临过各自的过度旅游问题，但即便以这个标准来看，

sentences.en: Dubrovnik was extreme.
sentences.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克的情况也十分极端。

sentences.en: On busy days, tourists could outnumber permanent old town residents about six to one.
sentences.zh: 在繁忙的日子里，游客人数与古城常住居民的比例可达六比一。

sentences.en: With a main thoroughfare less than a thousand feet long, this pressure on the city's charm was overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 由于主干道长度不到一千英尺，这种对城市魅力的压力令人难以承受。

sentences.en: By 2017, tourism had so overburdened the old town that UNESCO was threatening to revoke its World Heritage status.
sentences.zh: 到2017年，旅游业已使古城不堪重负，以至于联合国教科文组织威胁要撤销其世界遗产地位。

sentences.en: Mayor Mato Frankovic set out to save his city by sabotage, capping passage through the gates at 4,000 daily visitors and functionally banning new restaurants.
sentences.zh: 市长马托·弗兰科维奇试图通过限制手段来拯救他的城市，将每日通过城门的游客人数上限设为4000人，并实际上禁止了新餐厅的开设。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the tourists kept coming.
sentences.zh: 然而，游客们还是源源不断地涌来。

sentences.en: But then, around March 2020, they stopped.
sentences.zh: 但后来，大约在2020年3月，他们停止了。

sentences.en: After the Diamond Princess debacle, no more cruise ships appeared in the port.
sentences.zh: 在“钻石公主号”事件之后，港口再也没有出现过游轮。

sentences.en: Airplanes were grounded, then took flight again, ending an age of quick and easy travel and ushering in a new, slower one.
sentences.zh: 飞机停飞，随后又重新起飞，结束了一个快捷便利的旅行时代，开启了一个新的、更缓慢的时代。

sentences.en: Pandemic travel was arduous and impeded by naughty, sometimes contradictory governmental guidelines.
sentences.zh: 疫情期间的旅行十分艰辛，且受到繁琐、有时甚至是相互矛盾的政府指导方针的阻碍。

sentences.en: To travel under these conditions required an unhinged urge to take flight and a bureaucrat's eye for parsing fine print.
sentences.zh: 在这种条件下旅行，需要一种疯狂的飞行冲动，以及官僚般审视细则的眼光。

sentences.en: Brian Kelly, the founder of a website called The Points Guy, had both, plus a few million unused frequent flyer miles.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·凯利，一个名为“积分达人”网站的创始人，两者兼备，外加几百万未使用的飞行常客里程。

sentences.en: This was how, on Saturday, August 7th, he found himself heading from New York to Dubrovnik, to see the walled city with nobody there.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在8月7日星期六，他发现自己正从纽约前往杜布罗夫尼克，去看看那座空无一人的围城。

sentences.en: His trip began at 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 他的行程始于前一天下午2点，

sentences.en: the day before, with an express nasal swab at NYU Langone Medical Center.
sentences.zh: 在纽约大学朗格尼医学中心进行了快速鼻拭子检测。

sentences.en: Travelers arriving in Croatia were at that time required to present a negative corona test no more than 48 hours old.
sentences.zh: 当时抵达克罗地亚的旅客必须出示不超过48小时的阴性新冠检测证明。

sentences.en: Between test processing time and travel time, the tight window posed a logistical challenge.
sentences.zh: 在检测处理时间和旅行时间之间，这个紧迫的时间窗口构成了物流挑战。

sentences.en: But Kelly, as the face of the world's most popular credit card rewards blog, had plenty of experience interpreting strict guidelines.
sentences.zh: 但凯利作为全球最受欢迎的信用卡奖励博客的门面，在解读严格准则方面经验丰富。

sentences.en: For 10 years, readers had come to his site for help turning terms of service into free trips.
sentences.zh: 十年来，读者一直来到他的网站，寻求将服务条款转化为免费旅行的帮助。

sentences.en: In this way, the pandemic was another day at work.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度看，疫情不过是日常工作的一部分。

sentences.en: That afternoon, he posted footage of his nasal swab to Instagram.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，他在Instagram上发布了鼻拭子检测的视频。

sentences.en: Nine hours later, he shared his results.
sentences.zh: 九小时后，他分享了结果。

sentences.en: Negative.
sentences.zh: 阴性。

sentences.en: The following evening, he arrived at JFK ready to board a Virgin
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，他抵达肯尼迪机场，准备登上维珍大西洋航空飞往伦敦的航班。

sentences.en: Atlantic flight to London.
sentences.zh: 伦敦。

sentences.en: The business class ticket cost him 57,500 miles, plus $724 cash.
sentences.zh: 这张商务舱机票花费了他57500英里里程，外加724美元现金。

sentences.en: He eased his way through the TSA pre-check line and signed into the Delta Sky Club Lounge.
sentences.zh: 他轻松通过了TSA预检通道，并签入达美航空的“飞凡贵宾室”。

sentences.en: The airline, he knew, had a partnership with Virgin.
sentences.zh: 他知道，该航空公司与维珍航空有合作关系。

sentences.en: A bartender announced the evening special,
sentences.zh: 调酒师宣布了当晚的特惠活动，

sentences.en: 10,000 points for a bottle of Dom Perignon.
sentences.zh: 10000积分兑换一瓶唐·培里侬香槟。

sentences.en: On that day, the points guy, which publishes monthly cash valuations of the top 45 rewards currencies, had Delta Miles trading at 1.1 cent each.
sentences.zh: 在那一天，“积分达人”网站（该网站每月发布前45种奖励货币的现金估值）显示达美里程的交易价值为每点1.1美分。

sentences.en: Kelly did a quick calculation in his head.
sentences.zh: 凯利在脑海中快速计算了一下。

sentences.en: The deal was worth about $110.
sentences.zh: 这笔交易价值约110美元。

sentences.en: The same bottle of Dom at a restaurant might go for $250 or more.
sentences.zh: 同样一瓶唐·培里侬在餐厅可能要卖250美元甚至更多。

sentences.en: He ordered the champagne.
sentences.zh: 他点了香槟。

sentences.en: The flight boarded at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 航班于晚上10点登机。

sentences.en: Kelly counted just 12 passengers in the 44-seat business class cabin.
sentences.zh: 凯利数了数，44座的商务舱里只有12名乘客。

sentences.en: Everyone was wearing a mask, and some fell asleep wearing two, face and eye.
sentences.zh: 每个人都戴着口罩，有些人甚至戴着两个，一个遮脸，一个遮眼。

sentences.en: Flying during COVID is kind of like flying private,
sentences.zh: “在新冠期间飞行就像是乘坐私人飞机，”

sentences.en: Kelly told me later.
sentences.zh: 凯利后来告诉我。

sentences.en: I had my own A350 plane.
sentences.zh: “我拥有属于我自己的A350飞机。”

sentences.en: The transfer at Heathrow went smoothly.
sentences.zh: 在希思罗机场的转机过程非常顺利。

sentences.en: The flight touched down in Croatia just in time.
sentences.zh: 航班及时降落在克罗地亚。

sentences.en: Kelly presented his negative test results.
sentences.zh: 凯利出示了他的阴性检测结果。

sentences.en: Dubrovnik that day was near empty and majestic, saved by disease from the lure of its own beauty.
sentences.zh: 那天的杜布罗夫尼克近乎空旷且雄伟，因疾病而免受其自身美景的诱惑。

sentences.en: Kelly met up with his friend Mauricio, a furloughed fashion merchandiser from Miami,
sentences.zh: 凯利见到了他的朋友毛里西奥，一位来自迈阿密的休假时尚采购员，

sentences.en: and they made plans to meet up with more friends and all rent a boat to hop around the nearby islands.
sentences.zh: 他们计划与其他朋友会合，租一艘船在附近的岛屿间穿梭。

sentences.en: The idea was that by the time they docked again, they'd all have been in Europe for two weeks, freeing them up to travel on to other places.
sentences.zh: 他们的想法是，等他们再次靠岸时，大家已经在欧洲待了两周，从而可以自由前往其他地方。

sentences.en: This was sort of a loophole in the strict EU travel restrictions.
sentences.zh: 这算是欧盟严格旅行限制中的一个漏洞。

sentences.en: Kelly knew that international travel was not, at the moment, feasible for the average points guy reader.
sentences.zh: 凯利知道，对于普通的“积分达人”读者来说，国际旅行目前是不可行的。

sentences.en: But he had the points, the COVID status, and the time to allow his readers to travel vicariously through him.
sentences.zh: 但他拥有积分、新冠状态和时间，可以让读者通过他进行“代入式”旅行。

sentences.en: He had no idea when the world might reopen.
sentences.zh: 他不知道世界何时会重新开放。

sentences.en: For now, he was content to enjoy the solitude.
sentences.zh: 目前，他满足于享受这份宁静。

sentences.en: No cruise ships, no mass tourists, he says.
sentences.zh: 没有游轮，没有大众游客，他说。

sentences.en: Just the reigning king of cheap travel, enjoying a momentary upside to its downfall.
sentences.zh: 只有廉价旅行的王者，享受着其衰落带来的片刻红利。

sentences.en: The seeds of cheap travel were planted in the 1970s, as U.S.
sentences.zh: 廉价旅行的种子是在20世纪70年代种下的，当时美国航空业的放松管制降低了飞行的成本和奢华程度。

sentences.en: airline deregulation drove down the cost and luxuriousness of flying.
sentences.zh: 这种繁荣直到二十年后才开始，当时自助旅行网站削弱了旅行社的权力，

sentences.en: The boom would not begin for another two decades when self-book travel websites curtailed travel
sentences.zh: 消除了市场中相当大的摩擦，让消费者能更随意地飞行。

sentences.en: agents' power, removing considerable friction from the market and allowing the consumer to take flight more casually.
sentences.zh: 据联合国统计，2018年全球游客到达人数达到创纪录的每年14亿人次，是二战结束以来的56倍。

sentences.en: In 2018, according to the United Nations, global tourist arrivals reached a record annual high of 1.4 billion, a 56-fold increase since the end of World War II.
sentences.zh: 这种繁荣，像所有繁荣一样，有其明显的输家——当地人、环境，以及赢家。

sentences.en: This boom, like all booms, had its clear-cut losers, locals, the environment, and winners.
sentences.zh: 房屋共享平台、众包评论网站、渴望旅行的网红。

sentences.en: Home-sharing platforms, crowdsourced review sites, wanderlusting influencers.
sentences.zh: 在这其中某处就是“积分达人”，其领域是航空公司和信用卡发行的一系列新型货币。

sentences.en: Somewhere in this mix is the points guy, and its domain is the set of novel currencies issued by airlines and credit cards.
sentences.zh: 积分是你通过花费真金白银赚取的“空中货币”，是一种隐藏在另一种货币之内的货币形式。

sentences.en: Points are airsats money that you earn by spending real money, a form of currency hidden inside of another.
sentences.zh: 而忠诚度计划（该行业的统称）是企业内部的企业。

sentences.en: And loyalty programs, as the broader sector is known, are businesses inside businesses.
sentences.zh: 在非疫情的普通工作日，美国人可能会遇到六次赚取忠诚度积分的机会。

sentences.en: On an ordinary, non-pandemic weekday, an American might encounter half a dozen opportunities to accrue loyalty points.
sentences.zh: 从早晨的咖啡（星巴克奖励），到日常通勤（埃克森美孚奖励Plus），再到午餐

sentences.en: From morning coffee, Starbucks rewards, to daily commute, ExxonMobil Rewards Plus, to lunch
sentences.zh: 休息（Chipotle奖励），再到下班后的杂事（CVS Extra Care积分），再到约会之夜（Regal影院的

sentences.en: break, Chipotle Rewards, to after-work errands, CVS Extra Care Points, to date night, Regal Cinema's
sentences.zh: 皇冠俱乐部）。

sentences.en: Crown Club.
sentences.zh: 忠诚度计划在多大程度上真正增加了客户忠诚度，因计划而异。

sentences.en: The degree to which loyalty programs actually increase customer loyalty varies widely from program to program.
sentences.zh: 好的计划会悬挂一个刻意的诱饵，建立客户忠诚度，并提高行为经济学家所说的“转换成本”。

sentences.en: Good programs dangle a deliberate carrot, forging customer loyalty and heightening what behavioral economists call switching costs.
sentences.zh: 他们利用人们感知到的节俭和对地位的幻想，让用户想要赚取，从而进行消费。

sentences.en: They exploit perceived thrift and a fantasy of status to make users want to earn, and thereby spend.
sentences.zh: 在忠诚度计划领域，旅行信用卡奖励是迄今为止最成功、最广为人知的。

sentences.en: Within the loyalty program space, traveling credit card rewards are by far the most successful and well-known.
sentences.zh: 正如一位常被引用、几乎可以肯定是虚构的航空公司高管曾经说过的，人们愿意为一张免费机票支付任何代价。

sentences.en: As one oft-cited, almost certainly imaginary airline executive once put it, people are willing to pay anything for a free ticket.
sentences.zh: 旅行奖励构成了一种引人注目的激励，是通往全球精英游乐场的捷径，或者如果不是那样，

sentences.en: Travel rewards pose a compelling incentive, a shortcut to the playgrounds of the globalized elite, or, if not
sentences.zh: 至少是一个坐在飞机上可以免费享用鸡尾酒区域的机会。

sentences.en: that, at least a chance to sit in the part of the airplane where cocktails are free.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着奖励计划的激增，赚取的积分变得越来越复杂和可互换。

sentences.en: And yet, as rewards programs have multiplied, the earned point has grown increasingly complex and fungible.

sentences.en: He'd already collected several complimentary Conrad branded stuffed animals from his previous stays.

sentences.zh: 为了使MS方案盈利，赚取的收益必须超过制造消费的成本。

sentences.zh: 我交谈过的一位旅行黑客将MS方案分为两类。

sentences.en: Pajama spend, which you could do from your computer, and real-world spend, which took in-person work.
sentences.zh: “睡衣消费”，你可以在电脑前完成；以及“现实世界消费”，需要亲自去操作。

sentences.en: Manufactured spending was getting harder, as credit card algorithms became smarter at catching hackers.
sentences.zh: 随着信用卡算法在捕捉黑客方面变得越来越聪明，制造消费变得越来越难。

sentences.en: Increasingly, the profitable schemes involved arduous real-world effort, like driving between
sentences.zh: 越来越多的盈利方案涉及艰苦的现实世界努力，比如在沃尔玛门店之间开车

sentences.en: Walmart locations to buy money orders at a discount.
sentences.zh: 以折扣价购买汇票。

sentences.en: Some hackers I read about online build these pit stops into their real-job commutes as a kind of second shift.
sentences.zh: 我在线阅读到的一些黑客将这些“补给站”纳入了他们日常工作的通勤路线中，作为一种“第二班岗”。

sentences.en: Others, a small percentage, make travel hacking and other arcane arbitrage schemes a full-time occupation, reselling their points in secret

sentences.en: online markets against the credit card terms of service.

sentences.en: There are new financial products popping up every day, Graziano assured the crowd.
